question: Engineering says Figma colors don’t match production. How do you introduce design tokens and improve handoff?
questionBn: ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বলে Figma-এর রঙ প্রোডাকশনের সাথে মেলে না। ডিজাইন টোকেন ও হ্যান্ডঅফ কীভাবে উন্নত করবেন?
shortAnswer: Define semantic tokens shared by name, map them to CSS variables, and hand off states—not only happy-path frames.
strongAnswer: Inventory primitives vs semantic roles (bg, text-muted, danger). Align Figma variables with code names. Document empty/error/loading and a11y notes. Schedule a short pairing ritual so drift is caught early. Prefer meaning-based names so themes don’t break.
followUps: What belongs in handoff besides screenshots?
commonWrongAnswer: Send more screenshots and ask eng to eyeball hex values.
productionRelevance: Token drift is a common design-system failure mode on fast-moving teams.
integrationProcedure: 1) Reproduce the scenario in a small spike using Figma, Design tokens, CSS. 2) Write the strong answer as an ADR or PR description. 3) Add a test or monitor that would catch the common wrong answer in production. 4) Document rollback/owner. 5) Rehearse the follow-ups aloud once.
